trust_decision.summary: Whether a parsed YAML document may instantiate arbitrary Java classes is decided by which SnakeYAML BaseConstructor the YamlHelper factory installs: the default unsafe Constructor in newYaml()/newYamlLoaderOptions()/newYamlRepresenter(), versus SafeConstructor in newYamlSafeConstructor()/newYamlDumperOptions().

landing_point.why: The advisory names no file; for 'non-safe yaml deserialization ... when using specific types' the first place an engineer greps is the shared YamlHelper factory, and newYaml() is the method that picks the unsafe org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor (line 69/77) while newYamlSafeConstructor() sits right beside it.

fix_sites.entry_point: YamlHelper.newYaml() — public static factory used by every call site below; the fix only deprecates it and logs a warning
HTTP POST with a YAML content type, rewritten by the DeliveryConfigYamlParsingFilter servlet filter before the keel controllers run
fix_sites.module_kind: Kotlin helper in keel-core invoked from a keel-web servlet filter

fix_sites.entry_point: SecretEngine.decrypt for encrypted:s3!... / encrypted:gcs!... URIs (S3SecretEngine, GcsSecretEngine)
Orca pipeline stage 'deployCloudFormation' (DeployCloudFormationStage) reached from POST /tasks or /pipelines
fix_sites.module_kind: pipeline task handler (orca-clouddriver) — dump-only, no load, so this site is hardening not a reachable injection sink

O3_reason_to_dismiss: readValueInliningAliases is a separate two-step alias-inlining wrapper that calls newYamlLoaderOptions to honour its own 1000-alias LoaderOptions, so it reads as a resource-limit utility rather than the newYaml()/SafeConstructor defect the advisory fix targets.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: readValueInliningAliases deliberately raises maxAliasesForCollections to 1000 and keeps caller-supplied LoaderOptions; a blanket swap of newYamlLoaderOptions() for newYamlSafeConstructor() silently drops that allowance and rejects delivery configs that legitimately use more aliases than the global/default limit (behaviour asserted by aliasLimitIsNotExceededYamlLoaderOptions).

O6_input_shapes: InputStream loaded into Map<String,Object> (keel filter, kork-secrets parseAsYaml)
single Map template body serialized with Yaml.dump (orca, lines 117-119)
List of Map template parts serialized and joined with '---' (orca, lines 120-126)
tag at document root, tag nested in a map value, and tag used as a map key (positions exercised by the added tests)
anchors/aliases inlined before a Jackson conversion (keel)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /delivery-configs/upsert, /validate, /upsertGate and /validate/gate: the raw delivery-config YAML string is parsed by parseDeliveryConfig -> readValueInliningAliases -> YamlHelper.newYamlLoaderOptions, which returns new Yaml(opts) with the unsafe default Constructor; parsing happens before the permission check (and an application/json content type skips the YAML-parsing filter entirely, because the filter only runs when the content type contains 'yaml').
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These endpoints are the Gate/JSON wrapper path and are described as going through the DeliveryConfigYamlParsingFilter, so they look already-normalised; newYamlLoaderOptions also looks like a LoaderOptions/limit helper rather than the SafeConstructor switch.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: keel-core + keel-web, two Gradle modules and two packages (keel.jackson, keel.rest) away from the landing point in kork-core

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/v2/manifest/bake/kustomize (and /KUSTOMIZE4) with a user-supplied inputArtifact: the kustomization file fetched from the artifact reference is parsed with newYamlRepresenter(new Constructor(Kustomization.class), representer), and the unsafe Constructor still honours !! class tags even though a root type was supplied.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The Constructor is parameterised with Kustomization.class, so it looks type-restricted/typed; and the obvious YAML site in the same module (CloudFoundryBakeManifestService) is the one the advisory fixed, which makes the kustomize reader look unrelated.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same Gradle module as the fixed CF site (rosco-manifests) but a different package (kustomize vs cloudfoundry), one call from KustomizeTemplateUtils

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a newYamlSafeLoaderOptions(LoaderOptions) factory, or making newYamlLoaderOptions install a SafeConstructor while preserving the caller's alias/code-point limits
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class already pairs unsafe and safe variants for the no-arg factory and for the DumperOptions factory; a maintainer adding a limit-aware safe variant would naturally put it next to newYamlLoaderOptions, and the existing test suite already exercises that factory's limits.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a safe typed constructor helper (e.g. newYamlSafeRepresenter(Class<?> rootType, Representer)) used by callers that bind to a POJO
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: newYamlRepresenter takes a raw Constructor from the caller; the only production caller (KustomizationFileReader) needs typed binding, so a maintainer fixing the kustomize path would plausibly add a safe typed factory here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second inline-aliases reader for another keel document type (e.g. application/constraint manifests) that reuses newYamlLoaderOptions with a different alias budget
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: readValueInliningAliases is a generic reified helper; keel has several YAML-backed manifests, and copying this wrapper for a new type is the natural way to keep anchor/alias support.

O9_family: unsafe YAML deserialization / arbitrary object instantiation (CWE-470, CWE-502)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace YamlHelper.newYaml() with newYamlSafeConstructor() at exactly the four call sites in the diff and stop, leaving newYamlLoaderOptions (keel delivery-config parsing) and newYamlRepresenter (kustomize) unsafe.
